# Frozen pre-cure first-use forms

This fixture preserves one inflected or compound-form escape for each row of
the 24-row first-use audit. It is test evidence, not paper prose.

## Pre-cure uses

1. The member's edges moved.
2. The A/B/B/A blocks shared a sign.
3. The run was reasoning-disabled.
4. The declared machine-state stayed fixed.
5. The signal-checks passed.
6. The first-record endpoints were retained.
7. The calibration policies were fixed.
8. The entry-checks ran.
9. The reference-runs bracketed the work.
10. The gross-energy values were retained.
11. The frozen-entry checks passed.
12. The null-test blocks contained zero.
13. The package-power trace was integrated.
14. The sampling-cadence requirement held.
15. The workload levels' values were listed.
16. The retired calculations produced pilots.
17. The close-out records were checked.
18. The energy terms' variances were combined.
19. The named kinds were enumerated.
20. The hardware configurations' limits were reported.
21. The corner-bounds were compared.
22. The detection-floor values were printed.
23. The Figure 3 references were left as instructions.
24. The overlap-counts were reported.
